observability_limits.rule: 10.1.4 p5 permits pure elemental function element evaluation in arbitrary order or simultaneously. No conforming program can observe that order, and a function with side effects is not a legitimate detector.
observability_limits.audited_in_both_directions: The reviewer was required to check whether the unimplementability claim was also TOO BROAD, on the standing principle that an over-broad unobservability claim is itself a defect. Verdict: not too broad - observable value and shape facts were implemented, and the conditional-expression facets remain genuinely pending rather than suppressed.
observability_limits.what_this_packet_does_not_establish: No evaluation ORDER claim, no evaluation COUNT claim, and no claim that any particular operand WAS evaluated. A processor need not evaluate all of an expression if the value can be determined otherwise.

oracle_discipline.arithmetic: Exact integer arithmetic only. No real comparison appears in this packet, avoiding the 7.4.3 approximation and 10.1.5.2.4 reassociation hazards entirely.
oracle_discipline.no_self_referential_intrinsic: The SHAPE-based oracle was examined specifically to confirm SHAPE is not being used to prove something SHAPE itself supplies; the shape claim is corroborated by the independently derived element values.
oracle_discipline.compiler_consensus_not_an_oracle: Every expected value was hand-derived from the source. Agreement between gfortran and LFortran was treated as corroboration only, never as the oracle.

catalogue_review_renewal.why: Binding facets into a catalogue changes its content and therefore STALES its content-bound source review by design. Batches 118, 119 and 120 each shipped with this uncorrected; the defect surfaced only at batch121 when a gate failed.
catalogue_review_renewal.observed_here: After recording the 14 fixture reviews, the audit reported 10.1.4 as non-reviewed, exactly as the rule predicts.
catalogue_review_renewal.action: doc/catalogues/evaluation_of_operations_10_1_4.json source review renewed in the same integration, recording that the staleness is attributable solely to facet binding and that source accounting is unchanged.
catalogue_review_renewal.verification: After renewal the audit shows only 18.3.7 as non-reviewed, which is pre-existing in doc/catalogues/c_interop.json and predates this session.

explicit_limitations: This records executable effects for 14 facets of 10.1.4 only. It is not coverage of Clause 10, which retains roughly 1,000 pending facets.
No evaluation order, evaluation count, or operand-was-evaluated claim is established, and none can be.
The conditional-expression facets (S10.1.4-006, S10.1.4-007) and the S10.1.4-002 restrictions remain entirely pending.
Passing under two compilers is corroboration, not proof of universal conformance; no ABI or portability claim is made.
Source accounting is unchanged: declared_facets remains 7184 and no source unit was added, removed or redispositioned.
